label: Email
description: An email address, such as a contact or a distribution list. The server validates the format, trims whitespace, and lowercases the domain. Use a user field instead when the person is a member of the tenant.
usage: Use for external contacts who are not tenant members.
Use a user field for agents and requesters with accounts.
Mark unique only when the address really identifies the record (e.g. a vendor's billing contact).
constraints: Values must be a valid addr-spec (local@domain); the domain is lowercased on write and the local part is kept as typed.
Values are trimmed; an empty string is stored as null.

unique.description: Unique (case-insensitive) among records of the entity in this tenant environment.

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.keyboard: Standard text input (type=email). Esc reverts an inline edit; Enter commits.
accessibility.notes: autocomplete=email; in read mode the value is a mailto link named by the address.

responsive: Full width of its grid cell.

spec.label: Contact email
spec.help: Where updates go if the requester is not a tenant member.
